name: Aichun Beauty Skincare Eggs Collagen and Vitamin E Face Serum 30ml
description:
Aichun Beauty 99% Oil-Free Eggs Face Serum with Vitamin E – 30ml | Collagen & Whitening Formula for All Skin Types

Description:
Experience radiant and youthful skin with Aichun Beauty’s 99% Oil-Free Eggs Face Serum enriched with Vitamin E and collagen. Specially formulated to combat common signs of aging such as fine lines, wrinkles, dark spots, and sun damage, this lightweight liquid serum brightens and firms your face while deeply moisturizing. Suitable for all skin types, it contains powerful whitening agents like arbutin to enhance skin clarity and promote a glowing complexion.

Brand: Aichun Beauty

Country of Origin: China

Volume: 30ml

Usage Area: Face

Features: Collagen & Vitamin E enriched, 99% oil-free, face brightening

Skin Type: All skin types

Benefits: Reduces fine lines, wrinkles, dark spots; brightens and firms skin; moisturizes deeply
